name: Lookup tools
description: Finds records by the number in their name however it is typed, and pulls compound properties from PubChem.
author: Acme Bio

search-providers.title: Identifier, however typed
search-providers.description: Finds a record from part of its identifier or name, ignoring dashes, spaces and leading zeros.

connectors.title: PubChem properties
